name: Thorndale Jag Offs
description: Thorndale Jag Offs (TJO) was a white greaser street gang founded in 1962 by Joe Ganci at Thorndale and Kenmore in the Edgewater/Uptown neighborhood of Chicago. Originally called the Thorndale Jarvis Organization, the gang dominated the eastern Edgewater corridor through the 1960s–70s. Co-founder Gary Kellas received a 30-year sentence in 1986 for armed robbery of an undercover officer, after which the gang went extinct.
